decision_scope: Bounded full-value semantic acceptance of this exact one-key value. Not native-speaker, specialist, catalogue-wide, universal Nôm orthography, layout, runtime, or release certification.
transcription: Ước tính bao gồm khung vẽ hiện tại, bảng tạm, bộ đệm giải mã lấy mẫu và bộ đệm chỉnh sửa. Mức dùng bộ nhớ thực tế có thể thay đổi. Bản sao nhỏ hơn sẽ mất chi tiết. Tệp gốc không thay đổi.

clauses.source: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers.
clauses.target: 約 併 包 𠁟 椌 𡳒 現在, 榜 暫, 部 墊 解 碼 𥙩 㑄 吧 部 墊 整 𢯢.
clauses.assessment: The estimate remains approximate through ước tính; the list retains the current drawing canvas, clipboard, sampled-decoding buffer and editing buffer. 解碼 = giải mã, 𥙩㑄 = lấy mẫu; this is sampling-based decoding, not a test/example decode. 'Bộ đệm' makes the memory allocations explicit, consistent with the surrounding decoded-image and buffer estimate.

clauses.target: 𣞪 用 部𢖵 實際 𣎏 体 𠊝 𢷮.
clauses.assessment: Reads mức dùng bộ nhớ thực tế có thể thay đổi: actual memory usage can vary. The qualification does not promise a precise guaranteed allocation.

clauses.target: 版 抄 𡮈 欣 仕 𠅒 枝節.
clauses.assessment: Reads bản sao nhỏ hơn sẽ mất chi tiết: explicitly a smaller copy, with definite future detail loss, not possible-only loss. All three safety-critical elements are retained.

clauses.target: 𣜿 㭲 空 𠊝 𢷮.
clauses.assessment: Reads tệp gốc không thay đổi: original file does not change. Negation and original-file referent are present; there is no selected-background or white-backing promise.

evidence.supports: 併 = tính; direct entry opened and read.
𠁟 = gồm. Read in search-indexed primary-source text.

evidence.kind: Primary Hán-Nôm association character-list proposal, 2023 edition
evidence.supports: Indexed entries explicitly support 椌 khung (printed p.151), 𠅒 mất (p.181), 㑄 mẫu (p.182), 𣞪 mức with mức độ/mức sống (p.189), and 𢷮 đổi with 𠊝𢷮 thay đổi. Full PDF open returned HTTP403; claims here are limited to the actual indexed entries, not a claimed full-document inspection.
Indexed entry explicitly reads 墊 = đệm.
Examples pair 𡳒 with vẽ and 欣 with hơn.
Direct entry 仕 sẽ includes future-tense examples, not merely the unrelated sĩ reading.
𣜿 is paired with tệp. The computer-file sense comes from contemporary Vietnamese context, not the historical food example.
㭲 paired with gốc in several lines; 吧 with và.
Names the 2023 revised proposal and demonstrates 版 as bản. It is a publisher's standardization proposal; no claim of universal or government-mandated orthography.
Modern Vietnamese bảng tạm refers to the clipboard.
Technical context ties giải mã and lấy mẫu con to smaller decoded bitmap allocation and bộ nhớ; supports decoding/sampling interpretation, without being a quotation of this exact UI sentence.

limits: No native speaker or specialist was consulted, and this is not certification.
Nôm allows orthographic variants; the review checks the actual glyph readings and complete meaning, not a claim that these are the only accepted spellings.
Primary-source lexical/corpus evidence supports the reading; contemporary technical-compound interpretation is reviewer synthesis, not a directly attested full Nôm computing sentence.
Full primary association PDF could not be opened (HTTP403); only its search-indexed entries were used. Other primary dictionary pages were opened directly.
No Android/UI rendering or runtime testing was performed in this review.
